search_parameters.q: an api for google search data

text_blocks.answer: If you mean an API that gives you Google Search results/data programmatically, the main options are:

items.answer: Google Custom Search JSON API — official Google API for retrieving search results, but it has limitations and is geared toward programmable search engines.
SerpAPI — third-party API that returns Google Search results in structured JSON, including organic results, ads, maps, shopping, etc.
DataForSEO — SERP/data API with Google results and SEO-oriented datasets.
Google Trends API / unofficial alternatives — for search-interest/trend data rather than actual search-result pages.

text_blocks.answer: If you tell me what you need—e.g. organic Google results, keywords/rankings, Google Maps results, search volume, or Google Trends—I can recommend the best API and show you the request/response format.
